snippet.title: Murder at Castle Nathria Announcement Video
snippet.description:
Join Game Designers Liv, Cora, and Valerie as they investigate what’s new to Hearthstone in the next expansion, Murder at Castle Nathria! Meet Murloc Holmes, explore new Locations, preview ten new cards from the expansion. Murder at Castle Nathria launches worldwide on August 2 with 135 new cards, featuring 10 Legendary suspects, the new Infuse keyword, the all-new Location card type, and more!

Learn more about Murder at Castle Nathria: https://blizz.ly/3Or6fcK 
Read the 23.6 Patch Notes: https://blizz.ly/3HJiJuf
